headline: Ryman Healthcare Reports Profit Growth for First Half 2026
summary: New Zealand senior living provider Ryman Healthcare reported strong net profit growth in its financial results for the first half of fiscal 2026.
why: Ryman Healthcare is one of New Zealand's largest listed retirement village operators, serving as a key benchmark for domestic real estate and healthcare sectors.

impacts.name: Ryman Healthcare
impacts.why: First-half profit growth supported company operating earnings momentum.
